caption: Comment CHALLENGE and I'll send you the link to the $1K Challenge. It's $45, one time, for 30 consecutive days and one goal: $1,000 in total revenue. You get your personal $1K Plan with your number and what to do each week, 25 Reel ideas every week, 30 carousel and 30 Story templates, a Notion content tracker, a guide to auto-posting with your AI, and the full $1K Club Playbook. Prefer to go at your own pace? The $1K Club is $10 and gives you the plan to keep. Results not guaranteed; revenue is before costs.
